# 获取SDK接入地址

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /openapi/staff/login:
    post:
      summary: 获取SDK接入地址
      deprecated: false
      description: |-
        第三方向七鱼请求`SDK`接入地址的时候，七鱼会执行客服在七鱼的登录事件，并生成含动态口令的`SDK`接入地址返回给第三方

        接口调用及数据校验规则参考上面`数据校验`
      tags:
        - 通用说明/服务端登录
      parameters:
        - name: appKey
          in: query
          description: 企业的appKey，0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
          required: true
          example: '{{appKey}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: content-type
          in: header
          description: ''
          required: true
          example: application/json;charset=utf-8
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                staffName:
                  type: string
                  description: 客服在七鱼这边对应的客服名(此处对应的参数值为客服账号)
              required:
                - staffName
            example:
              staffName: admin
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                    description: 错误码。200表示设置成功。
                  message:
                    type: string
                    description: 请求错误时，填错误提示信息
                  result:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      sdk_url:
                        type: string
                        description: 生成的含动态登录口令的SDK接入地址
                      corp_code:
                        type: string
                        description: 登录客服对应的七鱼企业域名
                      token:
                        type: string
                        description: 动态登录口令
                    required:
                      - sdk_url
                      - corp_code
                      - token
                    description: code为200时，返回值有效。
                required:
                  - code
                  - message
                  - result
              example:
                code: 200
                message: ''
                result:
                  sdk_url: >-
                    https://xxx.qiyukf.com/toolbar/script/get?token=cb1ec3c43089493eb4039945685ebf51
                  corp_code: xxx
                  token: cb1ec3c43089493eb4039945685ebf51
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 通用说明/服务端登录
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845434-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
